title: Faces In Motion
statement:
Faces in Motion explores identity not as a fixed portrait, but as an emotional landscape in continuous transformation. A face emerges at the center of a fractured, metallic chamber — illuminated by shifting gold currents that ripple through space. The surrounding reflections burst, stretch, and collapse, creating a sense of internal pressure and release.

Subtle expressions flicker and dissolve before they can fully form — a tightening of the mouth, a moment of softness around the eyes, a brief hesitation. These emotional traces surface and vanish like memories, revealing the self as layered, unstable, and always in motion.

Rather than depicting a single identity, the work reflects the psychological tension between what we show and what we cannot contain. In its seamless loop, the face becomes a site of fragmentation and becoming — an atmosphere where vulnerability, resilience, and transformation coexist.
